buildPolicy: verify existing release artifacts; no rebuild
method: 5 fresh Node processes and 5 fresh Chromium processes per module; bytes fetched/read before timer; JS import, WebAssembly.compile and asynchronous init(module) measured separately; warm OS disk cache, no reuse of an engine process; WASM/input transfer excluded; browser import includes loopback JS fetch; five rounds rotate/reverse profile order after all builds finish; per-sample load recorded; runtime writers exercised after timing.
